sentences.text: Morelladon was a medium-sized euornithopod, a group of herbivorous dinosaurs, estimated to reach six meters in length and weigh two tonnes.
Its rear middle back vertebrae feature a unique depression that is 2.6 times higher than the length of its base.
A skeleton of this animal was discovered in 2013 by teams from UNED and the Universidad Autónoma de Madrid at the Mas de la Parreta quarry near Morella.
The species Morelladon beltrani was formally named and described in 2015 by José Miguel Gasulla, Fernando Escaso, Iván Narváez, Francisco Ortega, and José Luis Sanz.
The genus name Morelladon combines the location Morella with the Greek word for tooth.
The species name beltrani honors Victor Beltrán, the quarry owner who cooperated with the scientific research.
Morelladon lived in Spain during the Early Cretaceous, approximately 130 million years ago.
